title: Seacrest Beach "White Sands" 8580 E County HWY 30A
h1: Seacrest Beach "White Sands" 8580 E County HWY 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf-front- Private heated pool **Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $70 per day**- Complimentary beach setups provided each morning include 6 beach chairs and 3 umbrellas (service provided March 1-October 31)- Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- Multiple expansive, open balconies- Elevator- Carriage house- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 8 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Escape to sun-soaked days of unrivaled luxury at Seacrest Beach’s White Sands! Experience Gulf-front living in this 7,000-square-foot, Gulf-front Main House and Carriage House, accommodating 22 guests with 8 bedrooms and 8.5 bathrooms across 3 floors. Bask in the panoramic Gulf views from the expansive pool deck and step through the back gate to dedicated beach access!An opulent reflection of the beach setting, the Main House’s natural wood floors and plush furnishings evoke the shore’s soft white sand, while vast windows bring in the colorful water view. The open great room seamlessly merges the living area, a dining table, and gourmet kitchen for effortless entertaining. Craft meals with ease thanks to the kitchen’s top-of-the-line appliances, including a Wolf 6-burner stove, and mix cocktails at the adjacent wet bar. Outside, indulge in drinks by the pool and watch the resplendent Gulf glitter against the horizon. A gas grill, alfresco table for 8, and shaded seating area invite shared meals in the fresh coastal breeze. Traipse down the private boardwalk for a quick trip to the beach—the outdoor shower makes rinsing off salt and sand a breeze. When it’s time to retire for the night, this level features 1 guest bedroom with a full bed.An in-home elevator offers convenience as guests ascend to the second level to find a hallway wet bar and laundry room with 2 stacked washers and dryers. The 2 guest bedrooms each feature a plush king bed, private bathroom, and access to the Gulf-facing balcony, where guests can relax on the cushioned porch swings. The kid-friendly bunk room hosts 2 twin-over-twin bunks with 2 twin trundles.The third-level bonus room invites casual hangouts with a spacious sectional and 65” TV. A wet bar, as well as 2 primary bedrooms with king beds, private bathrooms, and access to the Gulf-front balcony, complete the level.Offering extra privacy, the Carriage House boasts a full kitchen, 4-person table, queen sleeper sofa, and TV. There are 2 guest bedrooms featuring private bathrooms—the first has a queen bed, the second has a king bed.Enjoy an unforgettable getaway at White Sands in Seacrest Beach. Exploring is easy with parking for 4 vehicles, 8 complimentary adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 22):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower Only SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk beds with Trundles, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub - Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub CARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments. You may also be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Unfortunately, the outdoor ice maker is not for guest use.

Experience Gulf-front living in this 7,000-square-foot, Gulf-front Main House and Carriage House, accommodating 22 guests with 8 bedrooms and 8.5 bathrooms across 3 floors. Bask in the panoramic Gulf views from the expansive pool deck and step through the back gate to dedicated beach access! An opulent reflection of the beach setting, the Main House’s natural wood floors and plush furnishings evoke the shore’s soft white sand, while vast windows bring in the colorful water view. The open great room seamlessly merges the living area, a dining table, and gourmet kitchen for effortless entertaining. Outside, indulge in drinks by the pool and watch the resplendent Gulf glitter against the horizon. A gas grill, alfresco table for 8, and shaded seating area invite shared meals in the fresh coastal breeze. Traipse down the private boardwalk for a quick trip to the beach—the outdoor shower makes rinsing off salt and sand a breeze. Offering extra privacy, the Carriage House boasts a full kitchen, 4-person table, queen sleeper sofa, and TV. There are 2 guest bedrooms featuring private bathrooms—the first has a queen bed, the second has a king bed. Enjoy an unforgettable getaway at White Sands in Seacrest Beach. Exploring is easy with parking for 4 vehicles, 8 complimentary adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle. Book today!
